v4_case_fields.absent_field_rule: Retain null/PENDING until source-bound actual evidence; a closed failure may explicitly mark NOT_PRODUCED with a source-bound reason. Never fill absent state/image/parameter/geometry data with zero arrays.
v4_case_fields.closed_failure_rule: Preserve nonzero native and reader exits; review failure evidence without promoting it to PASS. Parent notification and review precede final snapshot.
v4_case_fields.wait_reference_rule: Bind actual wait PID/startticks, raw status, exact log/source SHA and producer/observer closure graph; exit0 alone is insufficient

storage.external_free_observation_source: PARENT_REPORTED; not a fresh measurement by this panel builder

legacy_top_level_scope: V9 initial/858 records; V6 is explicitly under latest_native_camera_diagnostic, with same32 replay and fresh0

strict_group.group_union_definition: Each required anatomical region is observed in at least one of the three views; counts are per-view maxima, never a false cross-view surface union.

historical_V6_camera_diagnostic.original_beforeafter_meaning: Independent failed diagnostic confirms raw artifact correspondence; missing ENTRY keeps measurement lifecycle and actual GPU UNKNOWN
